en.sub: Pick a broth. Stack your bowl. Pay by weight. There is no wrong way to do this.
en.storyH: We don't plate it. You do.
en.storyBody:
Most restaurants decide what you eat. We decided not to. Walk the fridge, take what you want, as much or as little, then pick the broth it swims in. Our job is the broth, simmered from scratch every morning. The rest of the bowl is yours.

Since 2018 that has taken us from one shop on Elizabeth Street to twenty across four states, which we take as a sign the country agrees.
en.basesH: Start here. Everything else is your call.
en.buildH: Three steps. That's the whole system.

steps.d: Walk the fridge. Over 100 ingredients, fresh and frozen. Take what you like and skip what you don't.
One price per 100g. No per-item maths, no surprises at the till. Your bowl, your budget.
Hand it over, name your base, find a seat. It comes out bubbling.

en.appBody: Over $200 in vouchers the day you join, 100 points per $20 spent, and a permanent discount that grows with your membership level. Download the app and take 10% off your first order.

en.sub: Assisted self-serve means you build the bowl and we handle the fire. Here is the whole process, start to finish.

faq.q: How much will it cost me?
faq.a: You pay by weight, at one price per 100g, so the bowl decides the bill. Load it with greens and noodles and it stays cheap. Load it with prawns and beef and it costs more. You can see the scale while it weighs.
Our Signature Spicy Malatang and Stir-Fry Spicy Pot are properly numbing, the way Sichuan intends. If that is not your thing, Pork Bone, Tomato and Golden Pickled carry no chilli heat at all.
Plenty of the fridge is vegetarian, and the Umami Wild Mushroom Fried Rice is built for it. Note that most of our broths are started from pork or beef bones, so ask staff before choosing a base.
No. We are not halal-certified in Australia, and our signature broths use a pork bone base. We would rather tell you plainly than have you find out at the table.
No. Walk in, take a bowl, join the queue at the scale. Most of our shops are built for turnover, not reservations.

zh.sub: 半自助的意思是：碗由你配，火由我们管。以下是全过程。

faq.a: 按重量计价，统一每 100 克一个价，所以碗决定账单。多装青菜和面，就便宜；多装虾和牛肉，就贵一些。过秤时秤面朝着你，看得一清二楚。
招牌麻辣烫和干锅麻辣是地道的四川麻辣，够麻够劲。若吃不惯，猪骨浓汤、香甜番茄汤和金汤酸菜完全不辣。
冰柜里大量食材都是素的，野生菌菇炒饭更是专为素食者而做。但请注意，我们多数汤底以猪骨或牛骨起锅，选汤底前请先询问店员。
不是。我们在澳大利亚并未取得清真认证，招牌汤底以猪骨熬制。与其让您落座后才发现，不如提前讲清楚。
不需要。直接进店，拿碗，到秤前排队即可。我们多数门店为翻台而设，不接受订位。
